subject: Follow-ups: Sprint synthesis & exec asks - action tracker
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint synthesis & exec asks — follow-ups and deadlines

Thanks everyone for a focused synthesis in today's cross-functional sync. Below are the follow-ups I captured and the owners I think make sense. Please correct ownership or ETA inline. I've attached the exec-asks tracker (short tab per item).

Top-line exec asks (from VP review):
- 1) Short-term latency improvement for the hosted API path for chat (SLO target: 95th pct < 180ms wall-time).
- 2) QBR slide pack with cost delta scenarios for Dedicated vs Hosted for Acme.
- 3) Procurement checklist + proposed contract amendments for data residency clause.

Proposed owners / first pass ETAs:
- Latency micro-changes (profiling + hot-fix): Aditya — ETA: 2 weeks (11/08).
- Quant/infra quick wins (batching defaults + cache TTL): Dev — ETA: 1 week (11/01).
- QBR deck (cost scenarios + exec one-pager): Grace + Laura — ETA: 11/03.
- Procurement language and redline: Hannah -> coordinate with Sarah (Acme) and procurement@acme.com — ETA: 11/05.

Ask: Aditya / Dev — please add a short bullet in the tracker for the safety/risk tradeoffs if we push more aggressive batching quantization. Grace — can you confirm the slide template you'll use and whether you need numbers from infra?

Attachments: exec-asks-tracker.xlsx (workbook)

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, GTM Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint synthesis & exec asks — follow-ups and deadlines

Thanks Hannah — clear notes. Quick update from infra side:
- I ran a short profiling pass this morning against the current 8k context chat path. Root cause for the 95th pct blips looks pipeline scheduling + two hotspots in attention kernels at short seq lengths.
- Short-term plan: safe scheduling tweak + small kernel config change. No model change. I expect a ~12–18% improvement on p95 in staging. ETA: I can land the change and smoke test by 11/08 as you suggested.

Dev / Grace — I will need the expected production QPS spike numbers for Acme for the next quarter to validate this config doesn't regress CPU utilization. If you can drop QPS/day and expected peak windows into the tracker that will speed me up.

On batching: agree with caution on aggressive batching. Dev, please flag which workloads can tolerate increased batching (embedding vs chat) and propose default TTLs.

Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint synthesis & exec asks — follow-ups and deadlines

Adding color from product / QBR slides perspective. I grabbed the draft template and sketched two scenario pages (attached: QBR-ask-deck-v2.pdf). Notes:
- Scenario A (Conservative): Continue on Hosted with minor infra tweaks — shows baseline cost and projected 6% perf uplift from Aditya's plan.
- Scenario B (Dedicated trial): shows Dedicated reserved baseline with a short-term uplift in infra/ops cost but 25% reduction in per-token unit cost at projected QPS.

I need confirmation from Dev on the realistic cache TTL uplift and from Aditya on whether the 12–18% perf improvement is measured on identical request mix we use in the QBR estimate (chat-heavy). If not, call that out as an assumption.

Also flagging one product exception: Acme's request for a strict 30-day data residency hold (their legal team language) will likely require a small change to our retention routing and may impact our audit log pipeline. That is a non-trivial ops work item — Dev / Hannah, can we scope as a separate ticket (SLA exception request) and present estimated FTE in the QBR?

Thanks, Hannah — appreciate the clear owners. A couple quick replies from Acme:
- We can share a QPS forecast for Nov–Jan; I'll drop the CSV into the tracker by EOD tomorrow.
- The 30-day residency request: legal flagged this as a hard requirement for our QBR commitment. Can you confirm what "small change" looks like? Our procurement team is standing by (procurement@acme.com).

Also: do you have a preferred contact for the contract redline? If Hannah or Laura want to share an initial amendment we can have our counsel review alongside procurement.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sprint synthesis & exec asks — follow-ups and deadlines

Nice progress, team — thank you. Finalizing a short public-facing summary for the execs and the QBR pack. Final asks / commitments below (please confirm by EOD 11/05 if you are the owner):

1) Aditya — land the scheduling tweak + kernel cfg to staging and provide a short blameless runbook for the change. Confirmation needed: yesterday's 12–18% number is on our chat-heavy synthetic test; if you can include raw test config in the tracker that helps. Due: 11/08.
2) Dev — add batching/TTL guidance to the tracker and highlight workloads that cannot be aggressively batched (embeddings/low-latency admin endpoints). ETA: 11/01 (if you need more time say so).
3) Grace & Laura — finalize QBR deck with scenario A/B pages and one-pager for the exec team. Please upload final PDF to the Drive link and paste HubSpot deal summary into the doc. ETA: 11/03.
4) Hannah -> coordinate procurement redline with Sarah and Acme procurement. I'll drop a draft amendment to the tracker and ping legal for a narrow residency clause. ETA: 11/05.

I'll consolidate confirmations and publish an executive summary slide on Monday. If any of these ETAs are not possible, flag immediately and propose alternatives.

Attachments (for reference): exec-asks-tracker.xlsx, QBR-ask-deck-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, GTM Programs
Redwood Inference
